entries.headline: AUTOMATON previews 13Z's fast combat loop
entries.summary: AUTOMATON's new hands-on report describes a rapid loop of combat, upgrade selection and more combat with little waiting. Developed by Mixed Realms, 13Z is planned to support solo play and up to four-player co-op.

entries.summary: IGN relays game director Del Chafe's statement that extraction remains a major part of Marathon and will continue to receive updates. He also invited player feedback on what works and what needs improvement.

entries.headline: AUTOMATON interviews a researcher on gaming and social preferences
entries.summary: AUTOMATON publishes an email interview with Brian Confessor about earlier research, reader reactions, memories in games and digital communication. The papers appeared in July; the interview is the new material. The statistical associations do not establish that gaming causes social isolation.

entries.headline: Grave Seasons announces a March 2027 release
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays the publishers' announcement of a March 9, 2027 release for Grave Seasons, with March 10 shown in Japan due to the time difference. Developed by Perfect Garbage, the game combines farm life with a serial-killer investigation and is planned for Xbox and PC Game Pass.

entries.headline: Diablo V director discusses planning and character builds
entries.summary: IGN relays Joe Shely's statement that Diablo V will retain moment-to-moment execution mechanics while placing greater emphasis on planning and investment. He describes overcoming challenges with the right build as a design principle.
